snippet.title: Handle with Care! - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Handle with Care is a co-op delivery game where chaos is a part of the job. Survive street hazards, crack physics-based puzzles, and handle outrageous packages to survive till Sunday and earn your day off 📦🧨🍻
